_about: Configurable engineering rules. These drive GENERATED VIEWS, never stored
columns, so editing this file and re-running tools/build_geopackage.py changes
every answer immediately without touching a single row of data.
Recorded survey values are never overwritten. site.cores_recorded keeps what
the original design put there; v_cores_demand computes what the rule says; and
v_cores_variance lists where the two disagree so a human can adjudicate.

cores_per_drop._status: DERIVED FROM RECORDED DATA - not invented, but not confirmed by an engineer either. Confirm before any procurement decision.
cores_per_drop._evidence: ceil(apartments / 8) reproduces cores_recorded for 1993 of 2041 buildings (97.6%) that carry both values. Competing divisors: /6 matches 68.4%, /10 matches 83.2%, /4 matches 23.8%. The 1:8 ratio is consistent with a 1:8 optical split. The remaining 2.4% are surfaced by v_cores_variance for review rather than being forced to fit.
_formula_note: Evaluated per site. Available inputs: apartments, occupants, floors,
clients. Any input that is NULL makes the whole result NULL when
null_inputs is 'null_result' - the project never guesses a missing
measurement. Set null_inputs to 'treat_as_zero' only if you accept that.
cores_per_drop._round_note: Applied after the formula: ceil | floor | nearest | none.
cores_per_drop._bands_note: Optional: snap the result up to one of these values. Disabled by default - a per-building core demand of 1-4 is normal, and snapping it to orderable CABLE sizes would be a category error. Cable sizes live under cable_sizes below.

occupancy._status: UNCONFIRMED - used only if a rule references 'occupants' and the field app has not supplied it.
occupancy._note: Left null deliberately. The field app is expected to supply occupants directly; no default household size is assumed, because assuming one would silently invent demand.

cable_sizes._note: Cable core counts the project can actually order. Used by BOQ rounding and by validation, which flags any recorded core count that is not orderable.

boundary_repair._note: See decision D5. All 56 block boundaries are open LineStrings; the median gap between first and last vertex is 0.08 m and the largest is 2.53 m, so they are drawing slips rather than design intent.

quality_thresholds._note: Used by the QA views. A threshold being exceeded is reported, never auto-corrected.
